    🙏 Religions¶

    A central hub for Ge'orian religions and faiths.

    Primary Religions¶

    Erisdar¶

    • Erisian Church — dominant on Erisdar, worship of fabricated goddess Eris. Shadow-controlled.
    • Alegoria — northern Erisdar, worship of Julian the Dragon Tamer who became one with Fireborn.
    • Mannosta — North Erisdar, pagan faith of the Mann Order. Ancestors and stars. "Greatness of Mann" — Mann is the capital of the gods. In decline.
    • Spasian Faith — East Erisdar, worship of The Silver Bride as divine conduit to the creator. Only official religion in the Spasian Teocracy.
    • Shurtra — West Erisdar, star-born savior Mabode. Fierce enemy of the Erisian Church. Aenid Kingdom, Malbodor, Astravayne, Augagarten.
    • Ogoron — orc faith of Augamouth. The titanic orc who will avenge orc-kind and bring peace.
    • Yll-me — star-pattern pantheon. Mercur, Kille, Fezzanite Republic.
    • Charlmelism — faith of Aimeled. Former barbarian raiders, eternal rivals of the Erisian Theocracy.
    • Lyrical Followers — ancestor cult of the Lyrical Forest. Majority in Prosperity Port.
    • Elven Faith — the nature cults and elven gods of Elvennrin and Elvenkrad. The normal elfic religion, kept under Erisian pressure.
    • Onobor — paganism of Tetras. The Silver Bride as goddess and key to immortality. "Ring" in Tetrian.
    • Pitraism — faith of the Silver Republic. The gods love money and gold. Dwarven-inspired pantheon.
    • Suebism — pagan nature faith. Suebo, Direfirth, Yaro, Zane.
    • Palonism — Shurtra variation of the mage republic Palonia.
    • Sibbism — snake goddess faith of Xikxia and Zakarutia. 24 demigod sons believed to run the world's corners (myth).

    Catmen¶

    • Calism — catmen philosophy-faith. Pacifism, gentleness, self-greatening. Marko, most catmen of Lumina.
    • Sytrenis — the most ancient catmen religion, from the hero Masaaki Sytrenis, "the Diplomat." Most Lesser Catmen still believe in it. Great Cattos.

    Lumina (& Mia)¶

    • Gigaoism — theocracy of the Gigas Tribe: worship of a living telepathic dog-god (~290 AGD).
    • Maomism — Maoma Tribe creation faith (gods Tiodorus & Anedoris; beastmen as the rightful rulers of the rainforests; reformed to name the Gigas as enemies of the gods).
    • Lumism — Lumina Kingdom's imperial cult to the old Lumina Empire, with animism and jungle-animal reverence; goal of restoring the empire and the old beastmen ways.
    • Taosudism — the ancient troll faith (Orgor Kingdom, Mia): water is corruption, trolls are a pure race, dirt-tempered water is sacred.
    • Mukini Dirt-Faith — Mukini Tribe (Mia): all beings come from the dirt; the dirt is sacred; enduring earth-sculpture.

    Reformed / Heretical¶

    • Erinya — catmen heresy of the Erisian cult. Eris was a catmen woman who will return. Tolerated, not persecuted.

    Erisian Apostolic Institutions¶

    • Apostles of Eris — the seven apostles of the Church: Alexa, Draco, Niccas, Ever, Aris, Malich, Maldorn.
    • Alexa Church State — independent Erisian church state (Grimmel Peninsula)
    • Draco Order — order state within the Erisian Empire
    • Order of Niccas — independent order (Grimmel Peninsula)
    • Ever Order — order state within the Erisian Empire

    Dwarven (Worldwide)¶

    • Dwarvism — universal dwarven faith.
    • Coal Doctrine — southern. Peace, self-cultivation, communal living. Kobre, Lumina.
    • Diamond Doctrine — eastern. Commerce, wealth, growth. Dwarvengor, East Erisdar.
    • Emerald Doctrine — western. Mastery, efficiency, engineering. West and Central Erisdar.

    Dragons¶

    • Diocronism — the old dragon faith of war and conquest. Perfection of the race, conquest of all corners. Succeeded by Daicrodism after the death wars.
    • Daicrodism — the dragon faith of atonement: peace and prosperity for all beings. Secluded in Kramsadar.

    Demon Continent¶

    • Kirivs-bin — "the way of Kirivis." Demon warrior-spiritual path following their legends. The root of every demon sect.
    • Malgardism — Malgardian sect of Kirivs-bin (purple way). Malgardian Tribe + Tita miko priesthood; purity-of-form, smallness sacred.
    • Padamalgardism — Bloodcoast warrior subsect of Malgardism (red way). Bloodcoast red-haired Malgardian-human hybrids; padama knives, surf liturgy; minority Eris Church on same coast.
    • Zebekyo — Emberalden kobold faith. Father Dragon Zebe, shed-scale hatching; all Kobolds + Emberalden Lizardfolk; NOT a sect of Kirivs-bin.
    • Ignism — Blazeyard Flames faith. Atmosphere higher than soil; Aether-Lattice; Flame sect of Kirivs-bin (Kirivis as riser). Eldest Core.
    • Farsightism — Kutra Tribe owl-kin. Superpower as prayer; Ledger of the Far Sight; sect of Kirivs-bin to complete Kirivis's work.
    • Tolumin — Koebi Tribe green demons. Vash-ka, light-through-stone; unite the continent through shared sacred labor; sect of Kirivs-bin.
    • Demonism — Mountain Tribe Diablos ecumenical faith (Yak Island). Night-shift liturgy; "demonic" as open civic identity; sect of Kirivs-bin.
    • Gedarism — Xobkua giant faith. Prophet Gedar (~4,000y), goddess Miritha of fortune; ANTI-Kirivs-bin; cold war vs Asatru Empire; ally Zakarutia.
    • Ogoron — orc faith: titanic orc avenger → universal peace. Augamouth + Yakut (Yak subrace, Yak Island).
    • Kludosy — Estran High Catmen faith (Yak Island). Mutable genes (~90% catmen offspring); taboo on leveraging them; Central Erisdar persecution origin; NOT Kirivs-bin.
    • Oceanism — Yaoma Tribe merfolk. Ocean creatures perfect, land drafts; song-scrolls, tidal magic, pearl nacre; NOT Kirivs-bin.
    • Slimism — Glub Kingdom intelligent Slimes (Yak Island). Fission as sacrament, memory-sharing communion, radical equality; NOT Kirivs-bin.
    • Cubra Faith — Cubra Tribe plain Kirivs-bin (Yak Island); no sect marker; also covers Maomodor Kingdom plain Kirivs-bin (mainland, multi-racial). Neutral ground.

    Dissenbarg¶

    • Helism — pantheon of domain-gods. Corin (sea/commerce), Cletas (reason), Maokas, Tissas (war), Lobas (nature), Gaelen (construction).
    • Enkrad Order — Erisian church colony (founded ~227 AGD, Venner-supported).

    Luminous Sea Islands¶

    • Nyity — astronomical faith of Moriat (human kingdoms Mikrad & Underfern). Sky gods descended and created humanity through suicidal sacrifice — their blood became all humans. One of the oldest faiths on Ge'or (~4,000 BGD). Mixed minority in half-elf kingdoms Gomor & Gildenrise (majority Elven Faith, no official religion). Human kingdom Dukedam on Minir is Erisian instead.

    Tuba Continent¶

    • Mamanolism — animist faith of Mamanolo Tribe; worships all animals as divine (beastmen tribe, north Tuba).
    • Sytrenis — via Alkorri (Tuba Lesser Catmen tribe south of Mamanolo) — same as Great Cattos (Lumina), the diplomat Masaaki Sytrenis.

    Marti Continent¶

    • Ulasm — pagan animist faith of Coldspeople; worships eagles as divine + ancestor worship (Great Cold). Core in Brase (southwest of Germina), also Coldspeople enclaves in Maboro.
    • Xuashism — recent wolvesfolk faith of Kut & Oigopol (Marti); god Xuashi promoted from animistic pantheon chief to sole deity, incarnated as Eris in Erisdar — father and mother of all religions on Ge'or. Also practiced by Wolvesfolk minority in Germina.
    • Moplilly — ancestor-veneration cult of Kobra (Marti cold-adapted Snake People; same race as Xikxia/Zakarutia but separated thousands of years ago). Demigod father-founder Xanob is most prayed-upon.
    • Multi-faith: Germina — melting pot: Sytrenis (catmen, as Great Cattos), many Erisian Church, plus other faiths. Maboro — coastal multiethnic: Coldspeople/Humans/beast people/demon merchants — several religions, no single creed.

    Xeti Continent (and Kumir)¶

    • Wruowas — ultra-ancient faith of Koetebalo (Xeti ogre nation); cults Dabazi Ar Batr, the great serpent creator of all reality; celestial animism worshipping constellations as the serpent's scales.
    • Xuashism — also in Kyuu (Xeti Wolvesfolk nation south of Ograd) — same wolvesfolk faith as Marti's Kut/Oigopol.
    • Erinya — via Chuchao (Kumir Island, Xeti Erisdarian Catmen settlement, NW Kumir) — catmen heresy of Eris as catmen woman.

    Merratodoni & Crab Archipelago¶

    • Church of Krowretism — radical freedom-faith of Human Republic of Northeastern Merratodoni (refugees from Erisdar/Erisian Church ~100 BGD, now superpower unifying with Purple Coast as of 597 AGD, colonizing middle Merratodoni westwards) and Crab Union (Crab Archipelago, majority human + Seamen). Believes real human god is Krowret, the inner man — men descend from the gods directly — and monotheistic Eris religion is false; humans were deceived by demon Eris and must purify world from Eris and destroy her church; main sponsors of the Ironcloak. Absolute freedom (USA of Old Earth analogue).

    Karabar (Wolf Ocean)¶

    • Dresludo — god of the seas; faith of Karabar (Karabar Island, western Wolf Ocean). Believes Dresludo sent them to Karabar as penitence for sins; must achieve gnosis to be freed from suffering of earth.

    Lung Continent (Isolated)¶

    • Humanism — machine faith. Worship of absent humans as "sky gods." Born from The Elder's prophecy.

    Tabontabar¶

    • Ximioli — "the way of the dragon." Moderation, modesty, family devotion.
    • Xatarism — cult of family, tradition, and the emperor. Meditation and monks.

    Sun Archipelago¶

    • South Sun Imperial Cult — ancestor-worship fused with imperial divinity. Emperor descended from the Sun.

    Polar Region¶

    • Cult of Cleton — death cult of the Moonfang Dominion, child sacrifices to the Wolf God.
    • Pragmus — faith of the Angels: creation and employees of the god of Ge'or, sworn to perfect the world.

    See: Erisian church, polygamy, The Sacrifice Ceremony
